mapper.select: SELECT b.*,c.name category_name FROM book b JOIN category c ON b.category_id=c.id WHERE (#{keyword} IS NULL OR b.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR b.author LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR b.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND (#{categoryId} IS NULL OR b.category_id=#{categoryId}) AND (#{status} IS NULL OR b.status=#{status}) ORDER BY b.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book b WHERE (#{keyword} IS NULL OR b.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR b.author LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR b.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND (#{categoryId} IS NULL OR b.category_id=#{categoryId}) AND (#{status} IS NULL OR b.status=#{status})

SELECT c.id AS categoryId,c.name AS categoryName,COUNT(b.id) AS bookCount,COALESCE(SUM(b.total_stock),0) AS totalStock,COALESCE(SUM(b.available_stock),0) AS availableStock FROM category c LEFT JOIN book b ON b.category_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id,c.name ORDER BY bookCount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS bookCount,COALESCE(SUM(total_stock),0) AS totalStock,COALESCE(SUM(available_stock),0) AS availableStock,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE status=1) AS borrowingCount,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category) AS categoryCount FROM book
SELECT COUNT(*) AS availableBookCount,COALESCE(SUM(available_stock),0) AS availableStock FROM book WHERE status=1 AND available_stock>0
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET available_stock=available_stock-1,status=IF(available_stock-1>0,1,2) WHERE id=#{id} AND available_stock>0

UPDATE book b SET available_stock=GREATEST(b.total_stock-(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record r WHERE r.book_id=b.id AND r.status=1),0),status=IF(b.total_stock-(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record r WHERE r.book_id=b.id AND r.status=1)>0,1,2)
